name: Winter-sage
desc: Winter-sage (Krascheninnikovia lanata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Krascheninnikovia lanata is a species of flowering plant currently placed in the family Amaranthaceae (previously, Chenopodiaceae), known by the common names winterfat, white sage, and wintersage.
